verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents API-driven equivalents for several core workflows: an API onboarding path for building a custom UI, retrieving connected-account balances via API calls, and managing payouts. An official MCP server and CLI are also documented. However, nothing in the evidence claims full API/UI parity, and some features are presented as Dashboard or no-code tools (platform pricing tools, Dashboard account management, viewing disputes) with no API equivalent shown. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage for Dashboard-only features such as platform pricing tools and dispute review, a reachable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
